ncu_config.fp4_pipe_comment: sm__ops_path_tensor_src_fp4* counts NOTHING for the sm_120 mxf4nvf4 mma.sync path (verified 2026-06-07: CUTLASS NVFP4 GEMM = 0 on all ops_path counters; the QMMA instructions appear under pipe_tensor/subpipe_hmma instead). FP4 FLOPs therefore come from smsp__inst_executed_pipe_tensor.sum x 16384 (m16n8k64: 16*8*64 MACs * 2), applied ONLY to the fp4_pipe_classes. CALIBRATED: 5,570,560 insts x 16384 = 9.13e10 == 2*512*17408*5120 (Qwen3-14B FFN gate GEMM, exact).

metric_groups.groups_comment: Single-pass metric groups for BOTH phases. Multi-pass kernel replay needs a device-memory backup that dies (or wedges) on TMA-using kernels on this WSL2 consumer driver; decode used to run all 18 metrics in one multi-pass invocation, which is why the nvfp4-hybrid decode cell hung indefinitely (2026-07-25) while dense/moe happened to survive. Same grouping as prefill: each invocation stays single-pass.
metric_groups.sass_comment: SASS counters tolerate no companion counter (even gpu__time_duration flips the pass count and TMA kernels die on multi-pass replay) — the group carries no time; class time comes from the base group (identical --launch-skip/--launch-count window).

ncu_config.replay_comment: Multi-pass kernel replay needs a device-memory backup, and on this WSL2 consumer driver that dies with a driver-resource error the moment a TMA-using kernel (cuBLAS nvjet_*, CUTLASS sm120) is profiled. Application replay is no alternative for prefill: cuBLAS re-autotunes per process, kernel sequences differ across passes -> ncu 'Skipped'. BOTH phases therefore run several SINGLE-PASS ncu invocations per cell (metric_groups; max ~6 plain counters per pass, only ONE sm__ops_path_* per pass). Decode used to be exempt on the assumption that it has no TMA kernels in the hot path — WRONG: the nvfp4-hybrid decode cell wedged indefinitely on 2026-07-25 (GPU idle at 3%, container unhealthy, killed by hand) because CUTLASS grouped GEMM runs there too. dense/moe survived, which is why the assumption held for so long.
ncu_config.tc_groups_comment: One sm__ops_path counter per single-pass invocation (each rides with time+bytes so the invocation yields a self-contained FLOP rate). Per model family only the dtypes that can occur in imp's hot path are measured; FLOP counts are workload-deterministic, so TC + SASS groups run on restart 0 only — restarts 1/2 re-measure only the base group (time/bytes variance).
ncu_config.timeout_comment: Per ncu group. A healthy decode pass is ~2 min; the old 3600 s meant a wedged pass (observed on nvfp4-hybrid decode, GPU idle at 3%) stalled the sweep for an hour. On timeout the named container is force-removed and the cell is marked failed.
